'''Karbo's Gun Drop''' was a [[drop point]] maintained by the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arm dealer]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|gunrunner]] [[Nain Lup]], under his alias "Karbo Jaxx." A series of caves hidden by a waterfall under [[Telega Lake]], Lup used the natural formation to stash weapons and explosives intended for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="HS" />
